title: ImuLine
description: One line of the optional imu.jsonl in a capture bundle, schema_version 1 (docs/capture-bundle.md): one IMU sample, written by the Swift capture module. Both vectors are in the device frame (Core Motion axes: x to the right of the screen, y towards the top of the device, z out of the screen), not the camera frame. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: t only increases.

accel.description: Raw accelerometer reading in m/s^2, gravity included, converted from g (1 g = 9.80665 m/s^2).
